questions.text: What Confirmation Type is used in the Daily REM Process?
questions.explanation: The Daily Process uses Assembly Backflush as the Confirmation Type. Component Backflush is reserved for End of Month processing.

questions.text: What Confirmation Type is used in the End of Month REM Process?
questions.explanation: The End of Month process uses Component Backflush. This is when the full component list (materials consumed during the month) is reviewed and posted.

questions.text: Why are components NOT posted during the daily REM confirmation?
options: Because daily component posting is not supported in SAP
Because components are too small to track individually
Because REM settles variance at Month-End, so components are only posted then after inventory is confirmed
Because the REM system automatically posts components at midnight
questions.explanation: In REM environments, variance is settled at Month-End — not per order. Components are only posted at month-end after inventory availability is confirmed, to match actual consumption.

questions.text: What material and production version are used for the REM confirmation at Plant 1100?
questions.explanation: The REM confirmation at Plant 1100 uses Material 920 and Production Version 120 — the batch appears automatically during the confirmation.

questions.text: In the End of Month process, what happens if inventory is NOT available?
options: A manual adjustment is created automatically
The process returns to the Component List to resolve the shortage
Components are marked as 'variance' and excluded
questions.explanation: The End of Month process has a decision point: 'Is Inventory Available?' If NO, the process loops back to 'Process Component List' to resolve the shortage before saving.

questions.text: What is the starting point event before the daily REM process begins?
options: Creating a production order in CO01
GR Pullet 64WK — Goods Receipt posted for live birds arriving at the processing plant
Running COOIS to check placement plan
Posting a purchase order for live broilers
questions.explanation: The starting point is GR Pullet 64WK — a Goods Receipt posted for the assembly backflush starting point, representing live birds arriving at the processing plant before daily confirmations begin.

questions.text: What does the 'Add the Classification' step add to the daily confirmation?
options: Classification data such as grade and weight class
questions.explanation: The 'Add the Classification' step adds classification data — for example, grade and weight class — to the REM confirmation before it is saved.

questions.text: Which plant uses the REM Confirmation process?
questions.explanation: Plant 1100 (Processing) is the REM plant where the REM Confirmation (MF42N) process is used for daily and month-end confirmations.
